name: Aggression, 26 December 2003 (Best of 2003)

date.source: the show's own script, which opens "EPW Aggression - December 26, 2003 EPW Studios - Los Angeles, California" (Wayback capture, 4 January 2004); a Friday, the fed's own Aggression night; Argyle's booking record (5722) gives the same date

notes: A clip show, not a card of its own: Cole Porter hosts from the studio and counts down the four best moments and four best matches of the 2003 Aggression episodes by the fans' vote. Every bout and angle on it is footage of an earlier show (21 August, 28 August, 4 September, 11 September, 5 December and 19 December 2003), replayed with the original commentary, so none is recorded here as a new match or appearance, under the anti-double-count rule; the studio host is the only presence the night itself adds. The script is served whole on the page named above.
